function: Downlink channel estimation (ResNet-DQ de-quantizer plus GMMV-LAMP) and CSI feedback compression (CSI-ResNet) for wideband UM-MIMO under hybrid near- and far-field beam squint (pp. 1, 5).
system: Single-cell downlink, hybrid-array AP with 128-512 antennas and 2 RF chains, single-antenna UEs with low-bit ADCs, 70 GHz, 10 GHz bandwidth, no RIS (pp. 5, 12).
method: Deep unfolding GMMV-LAMP, ResNet-DQ de-quantizer and CSI-ResNet autoencoder; supervised NMSE losses, three modules trained separately in sequence (p. 11).
data_channel: Own simulated far-field, near-field and hybrid-field multipath datasets from a Saleh-Valenzuela-based model, 150000 training and 30000 test samples (pp. 6, 12).
test_conditions: Training and validation sets have identical features, SNR -10 to 10 dB; mismatch test trains on far-field or mixed data, tests on hybrid field (pp. 12, 15).
baselines: Non-learned: GMMV-AMP, SOMP, frequency-flat DFT and polar-domain dictionaries; learned: MMV-LAMP [20] and CSI-Net [31]; ablations without ResNet-DQ (pp. 13-16).
metrics: De-quantization NMSE, estimation NMSE and reconstruction NMSE versus SNR, antennas, pilots, bandwidth (pp. 12-16).
complexity: Table III gives test-stage order O((GVK+K^2)T+GN_APK) for GMMV-LAMP against GMMV-AMP, MMV-LAMP and SOMP; converges in T = 5 layers (pp. 13-14).
q1_support: p. 12: "we generate different datasets for training"; p. 6: "According to the mmWave multipath Saleh-Valenzuela channel model [55]"; the channels come from a custom generator, with no 3GPP model, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 15: "The performance losses for the other two cases are clearly attributed to the model mismatch of the purely far-field and purely near-field CSI"
q3_support: p. 13: "outperforms the above two candidate approaches, in terms of CE accuracy and convergence speed"; p. 14: "we also provide the results of simultaneous OMP (SOMP) mentioned in [17]"; p. 16: "achieves significantly better reconstruction accuracy than CSI-Net"
q4_support: p. 14: "The computational complexity of all candidate channel estimation approaches is compared in Table III"
q5_support: p. 17: "We release our code at https://gaozhen16.github.io/ to facilitate further research and reproducibility"
notes: Area 2: ResNet-DQ and GMMV-LAMP estimate the downlink channel and CSI-ResNet compresses it for feedback. q1 not met: the Saleh-Valenzuela-based simulator is custom and no 3GPP model or measured data is used (pp. 6, 12). q2 rests on the Fig. 16 mismatch test, where training on purely far-field or mixed far/near data is tested in the hybrid scenario (p. 15); elsewhere training and validation sets have identical features (p. 12); reviewer to confirm. q3 baselines: GMMV-AMP and SOMP are non-learned, MMV-LAMP [20] and CSI-Net [31] are earlier learned methods, compared on NMSE (Figs. 12, 21, Table II). q5 rests on a code link to the authors' group page (p. 17), not checked.
